summary: Saint Andrew was the first apostle called by Jesus and a model of eager discipleship. His generous response to Christ continues to inspire mission.
antiphon_text: Let us remember Saint Andrew as a faithful witness to the love and mercy of Christ.
prayer_text: Lord God, through the life of Saint Andrew, strengthen us to follow your path with courage and charity. Grant us the grace to bear faithful witness in our own time. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
